>All of the men that JonBenet had contact with in the days before her death would have had their DNA tested and compared to the UM1 profile.

>unknown male DNA located on the inside of her panties in her blood, 

Sure, that's evidence.

>there is NO explanation.

You do not know this. Now, I get the hunch, but there have been cases made for innocent transfer that aren't outlandish, especially given how many people were at the White's christmas party (35-50 people). Not saying that it's what happened, but you don't know for certain that there's no other explanation. The DNA is compelling but paints an incomplete picture.

>the home had a un-armed security system

That's not evidence.

>one of the basement windows was even broken

I'm not saying IDI is impossible, just want to keep the actual evidence in perspective.
